title: Normalization of the two reduced finite projection inputs
statement: For completed integral inputs K on X and L on Y, finite scalar extension using pbcDerivedExtend and using scalarReductionDerivedExtension gives canonically isomorphic realized finite projection arrows. The source is the realized tensor-coordinate finite projection at the inverse realizations of the pbc scalar inputs; the target is the realized native finite projection at the inverse realizations of the normalized scalar inputs. This is only finite input transport, and involves no completed projection arrow, proper scalar mate or open scalar comparison.

source.place: Naturality in both inputs of the compactification projection, together with the canonical finiteReductionIso in IntegralCompactSupportCoefficientComparison.

proof.text: Evaluate finiteReductionIso at K and L. Map these isomorphisms through the inverse intrinsic realizations to obtain isomorphisms of the two native finite inputs. Naturality of the compactification projection in its first and second variables produces a commutative square. Its endpoint maps are the source and target bifunctors applied in order to the two input isomorphisms, hence are isomorphisms. The source arrow is projectionTensorCoordinateComponent by its defining equation. Map the resulting arrow isomorphism through the forward intrinsic realization. The endpoints and arrows are the displayed ones. The same argument includes zero inputs, empty schemes, the residue quotient and identity compactifications.

proof_origin.place: M4: input transport by canonical finiteReductionIso and naturality of the published compactification projection; no proper or completed projection statement in this part.

theorem integralOrdinaryProjection_reducedInputsNormalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f) (n : ℕ)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X))
    (L : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E Y)) :
    let A := Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)
    letI : Finite A := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
    let a := PurCompactSupport.reduction l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
    Nonempty (Arrow.mk ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y A).functor.map
      (projectionTensorCoordinateComponent (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} A)) c
        ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X A).inverse.obj
          ((pbcDerivedExtend (a.map X)).obj K))
        ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y A).inverse.obj
          ((pbcDerivedExtend (a.map Y)).obj L)))) ≅
      Arrow.mk ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y A).functor.map
        (((ProEtale.projectionMapOfCompactification
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} A)) c).app
            ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X A).inverse.obj
              ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K))).app
            ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y A).inverse.obj
              ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E Y n).obj L)))))
